Ond's first beta of 0.7.0: Ond can now update itself. Everything else is as in 0.6.0.

Ond 0.6.0 and other full releases don't offer betas. To try this one, download it below; from here on, Ond tells you when the next one is out.

### Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `Ond-0.7.0-beta.5-macos-universal.dmg` (or `.zip`) | macOS 11 or later, Apple silicon and Intel |
| `Ond-0.7.0-beta.5-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Linux on x86_64, glibc 2.39 or newer |
| `Ond-0.7.0-beta.5-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | Linux on ARM64, same requirements |
| `Ond-0.7.0-beta.5-windows-x86_64.zip` | Windows 10 and 11 |

The `.minisig` files are signatures. Ond checks a download against them before it installs an update. Betas 1 to 4 were test releases and have been removed.

### Updates

- When a newer version is out, Settings › About offers **Install**, which downloads and checks it inside Ond, and **Get from GitHub**, which opens its release page. After Install, Restart to Update installs it; quitting installs it too, without reopening Ond.
- **Install updates automatically**, off by default, downloads each update when it's found and installs it the next time you quit.
- The **Channel** row chooses between Releases, which offers only full releases, and Betas, which offers the newest version, beta or full release. Until you choose, a beta follows Betas and a full release follows Releases.
- Ond installs updates itself from the macOS app in Applications (or another writable folder), from a Linux archive installed with `install.sh`, and from the Windows zip. Elsewhere, such as a copy run from the dmg, About offers only Get from GitHub and says why. A Nix install doesn't look; Nix updates it.
- Home Manager can set both: `updates = "install"` and `update_channel`, in [docs/home-manager.md](https://github.com/Solidsilver/ond/blob/ond-v0.7.0-beta.5/docs/home-manager.md).

### Please report

If an update doesn't install, Settings › About says why. Please report it with your OS, how you installed Ond, and that message.
